mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Fan (first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, occupation) VALUES (#{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{email}, #{phoneNumber}, #{occupation})
INSERT INTO Preference (fan_id, stand_id, reservation_time) VALUES (#{fanId}, #{standId}, #{reservationTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Fan WHERE LOWER(first_name) = LOWER(#{firstName}) AND LOWER(last_name) = LOWER(#{lastName})

SELECT f.fan_id AS fanId, f.first_name AS firstName, f.last_name AS lastName, f.email AS email, f.phone_number AS phoneNumber, f.occupation AS occupation, p.stand_id AS standId, p.reservation_time AS reservationTime FROM Fan f JOIN Preference p ON f.fan_id = p.fan_id ORDER BY p.reservation_time;
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM Preference; DELETE FROM Fan;
